title: Agent Self-Improvement with Frozen Weights: The Added Value and Limits of Failure Traces
abstract: arXiv:2611.11342v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We evaluate whether an AI agent's harness, the notes around its model, can learn from the agent's failure traces beyond a matched search that never sees them. It can, but less than it looks. We tested an open 9-billion-parameter model with fixed weights; a larger teacher model wrote its notes. On generated customer-service decisions, where both note writers were told the target rules, notes based on the agent's mistakes improved accuracy by 4.0 percentage points over notes from the same process with the mistakes withheld. That process alone, trying and keeping better-scoring notes, reached about 60% of the total improvement. In full customer-service conversations the same notes showed no demonstrated improvement. translated_title: 模型权重冻结下的智能体自我改进：失败轨迹的附加价值与局限
translated_abstract: 我们评估了AI智能体的“脚手架”（即围绕模型的笔记系统能力）能否从智能体的失败轨迹中学习，并超越从未接触这些轨迹的匹配搜索过程。结论是：可以，但效果不如表面上看起来那么显著。我们测试了一个权重固定的开源90亿参数模型，由更大的教师模型为其撰写笔记。在生成的客服决策任务中（两个笔记撰写者均被告知目标规则），基于智能体错误案例的笔记比同一流程下隐去错误信息的笔记提高了4.0个百分点的准确率。而仅凭“尝试并保留得分更高笔记”这一流程本身，就已达到总改进的约60%。在完整的客服对话中，同样的笔记未表现出可证实的改进。此外，通过严格筛选单条经验教训，系统纳入了两条客服经验教训（尚待新数据测试）以及一条在未接触智能体错误的情况下撰写的工具使用经验教训，后者未表现出可证实的（改进）。
tldr: 该研究发现，在模型权重冻结的前提下，基于智能体失败轨迹撰写的笔记仅带来有限的额外改进（客服决策准确率提升约4个百分点，其中约60%可由单纯搜索过程实现），且在完整客服对话中无可见改进，揭示了失败轨迹作为学习信号的价值与局限。
en_tdlr: With frozen model weights, notes derived from an agent's failure traces yield only modest additional gains (about 4 percentage points on customer-service decisions, roughly 60% of which comes from search alone) and show no demonstrated improvement in full conversations, revealing both the added value and the limits of failure traces as a learning signal.
